title: Word Pattern
description: Check if a string follows a pattern of word-to-character mappings.

data.text: Given a `pattern` and a string `s`, find if `s` follows the same pattern. Each letter in `pattern` maps to a non-empty word in `s`, and no two letters map to the same word.

data.title: Bidirectional map O(n)
Last-seen index O(n)
What improved?
data.text: Storing the last-seen index for each pattern char and word lets us check consistency in one pass without storing full strings in the dictionary.

cards.title: Two Dictionaries
cards.description: Map char to word and back
